name: [VERY SOON] Depthless RPG
desc:
Welcome to Depthless RPG!

Depthless RPG is a fast paced modernized & classic RPG game where the player's goal is to defeat monsters and attain superior armor, accessories and weapons.  There are many areas to discover along with many mobs to defeat, where will your journey take you?

Tags:
RPG, Luck, Fun, Fighting game

scripts.title: Panhub
scripts.features:
Depthless RPG Script (PanHubV2)

Projectile KillAura – Auto attacks nearby enemies (adjustable range).

Parry – Auto-parries enemy attacks (custom delay & range).
Portal Teleport – Instantly teleport to any portal.

oved Halloween Event (Mobs/Teleports etc...)

----------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------
QOL-2 :Quest NPCs dropdown now sorts alphabetically.
----------------------------------------------------
Quests :Added new Auto quest toggle, so that you don't need to click on the button each time to get a new one.

- Added Halloween Event, (Zones, Mobs ignore, Buy key, Teleports etc..)
- Added all new potions and a new Auto use potions (turn on the toggle and equip a potion in hand.)
- QOL : Added Tips, Prices for items, moved buttons so it's cleaner and more .

=====================================================
